product_family: Subscription Management and Recurring Billing Platform

certifications.name: PCI-DSS Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: Recurly is PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant, and recognized on the Visa Global Registry of Service Providers. We meet or exceed all industry-standard payment security practices to protect you and your customers.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center lists 'SOC 1 Type II Report' and 'SOC 1 Type II Bridge Letter' under 'Independent third-party attestations and certifications that validate Recurly's security and compliance posture.'

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: We're SOC II Type 2 and PSD 2 compliant and meet CCPA, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements. We engage third party auditors and pentesters to ensure the highest quality standards.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center lists GDPR badge under certifications. Privacy policy includes a full 'General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)' section. A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is publicly available.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: We're SOC II Type 2 and PSD 2 compliant and meet CCPA, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements.

certifications.name: PSD2
certifications.proof_quote: We're SOC II Type 2 and PSD 2 compliant and meet CCPA, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Recurly states 'Recurly's compliance with HIPAA guidelines allows us to securely manage health information' but describes this as 'guidelines' alignment, not a formal certification. Privacy policy explicitly states 'Recurly's website is not intended to collect or process health information protected under HIPAA unless you have a separate agreement with Recurly for HIPAA-covered services.'

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 found on any Recurly-owned domain including trust.recurly.com, recurly.com/legal/security/, or recurly.com/product/security-compliance/.

privacy.ai_training_note: Recurly Compass (AI product) is explicit: 'No, Recurly does not currently use merchant data for AI training.' The AI system uses Google Vertex AI, Gemini LLM, and a RAG model. Merchant data is anonymized per Recurly's Privacy Policy. Merchant and subscriber data is never shared with competitors.
privacy.data_region: Primary: US (Google Cloud Platform). Processing also occurs in Brazil, Colombia, EU, India, Mexico, Philippines, Ukraine, and the United Kingdom per the Customer Data Processing Locations page (last updated June 18, 2026).

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Multiple layers of encryption in a segmented network with no public internet access. Keys managed via Google KMS, rotated on a regular basis.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS v1.2 or above for all data in transit over public networks.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on Google Cloud Platform. Dedicated hosting environment with 24x7 security and strictly segmented private networks.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Internal and external network penetration tests performed on a regular basis by third parties. A 'Recurly Security PenTest Report' is available via the Trust Center.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Two-factor authentication and strong password controls required for administrative access. Supports SAML, SSO, and configurable user role and permission controls. Audit logs reviewed regularly.

security.name: Bug bounty / responsible disclosure
security.value: No public bug bounty program on HackerOne or Bugcrowd identified. No security.txt file found at recurly.com/.well-known/security.txt (returned 404). Pen test reports available to customers via Trust Center.

security.name: CAIQ questionnaire
security.value: A CAIQ Security Questionnaire is available for download via the Trust Center.

security.name: Business continuity
security.value: Recurly Business Continuity Disaster Recovery Plan (TOC) available via Trust Center.

products.name: Recurly Subscriptions
products.data_scope: Cardholder data, subscriber PII, transaction and billing data, plan configurations. PCI-DSS Level 1 scope applies fully. SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II audited.
products.notes: Core product. Handles payment processing, plan management, dunning, revenue recovery. Visa Global Registry of Service Providers listed.

products.name: Recurly Commerce
products.data_scope: Shopify merchant subscriber data, billing events. Same underlying security posture as Subscriptions.
products.notes: Native Shopify app for subscription management. Integrates with Recurly billing.

products.name: Recurly Engage
products.data_scope: Subscriber behavioral data, in-product interaction data. Privacy policy explicitly carves out a separate section for Engage users with distinct data handling.
products.notes: Chat features powered by Zendesk and Google Gemini. Privacy policy requires Engage-specific review.

products.name: Recurly RevRec
products.data_scope: Revenue and billing data for compliance reporting. No cardholder data directly handled.
products.notes: Closes the books, automates audit-ready revenue compliance reporting.

products.name: Recurly Compass
products.data_scope: Anonymized merchant and subscriber data used for insights. No training on merchant data. Runs on Google Vertex AI (Gemini LLM + RAG).
products.notes: Explicit commitment: merchant data not used for AI model training. Outputs may include inaccurate information per their disclaimer - verify independently.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription, likely transaction/volume-based tiers. Free sandbox available; demo required for enterprise pricing.
compare.data_residency: Primary US (Google Cloud). Processing supported in EU, UK, and 7 additional jurisdictions. EU DPA available.

flags: HIPAA posture is guidelines-based alignment, not a formal HIPAA certification; a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) requires a separate agreement with Recurly - verify before healthcare use
No public bug bounty program (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) identified; security.txt returned 404; responsible disclosure path unclear for external researchers
ISO 27001 not referenced anywhere on Recurly's own domains despite enterprise scale and payment data handling
Recurly Engage has distinct data handling terms - review the product-specific privacy policy section before deploying
Data processing occurs in Ukraine per processing-locations page updated June 18, 2026 - assess geopolitical risk for sensitive data workloads
Recurly Compass AI disclaimer: outputs 'may include inaccurate information' and require independent verification
